title: Monocyte-derived dendritic cell response to leptospires
description: The comparison of the monocyte-derived dendritic cell response to pathogenic leptospires (L. interrogans serovar Pomona and a clinical isolate of L. interrogans) and non-pathogenic leptospires (L. biflexa serovar Patoc and L. meyeri serovar Ranarum) was conducted after stimulation for 4 hours.
